_triage.timestamp: SchnorrVault compares block.timestamp against intent deadlines (IntentExpired) and the daily-limit time lock (IncreaseNotMature), and derives the UTC day for rate limiting. Validator timestamp drift (seconds) is irrelevant at these granularities (deadlines chosen by the signers, a 2-day lock, 1-day windows); this is intended use, not randomness or ordering.

These are parser limitations inside a dependency; the analysis of SchnorrVault completes and the guard is covered by test_reentrancyIsBlocked.
